description:
INSTALLATION OF TWO FLUSH ROOFLIGHTS ON THE
NORTH-EAST-FACING PITCHED ROOF.
decision_conditions:
Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.
